title: Design System: UK CBAM Public Website

display.purpose: Home headline and closing call to action only.

headline.purpose: Every section heading and every interior page title.

title.purpose: Box titles, card titles, result headlines.

lead.purpose: Paragraph under a chapter heading; max 60ch, faded ink.

caption.purpose: Meta lines, footer snapshot data, small notes in boxes.

label.purpose: Uppercase box heads, table heads, field-group names. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

figure.purpose: Money, mass, dates, codes and counts; mono, tabular, slashed zero.

figure-lg.purpose: The single large value inside a box.

shadows.name: underprint
shadows.purpose: Hard offset behind buttons at rest; shrinks to 1px on hover and 0 on active as the button presses in.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Tool input panels, result boxes, filter boxes, open workings rows.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover and focus-within of a whole-box guide link; liability preview tool frame.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: State changes: button press, colour, disclosure icon.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Settle reveal: opacity plus scale from 0.985, no vertical drift.

focus.purpose: Global focus ring; ink on paper, light zinc in dark sections.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action colour; presses into its underprint on hover.

narrative.overview:
The site is laid out like the artefact it helps an importer produce: a customs declaration. Content sits in labelled boxes on cool zinc-white paper, lists are ruled ledgers closed by a heavy ink rule, figures run in a mono column with tabular digits, and the provenance of every value is marked with a double-ruled ink stamp. Aubergine stamp ink carries action and fills the dark sections and footer; everything else is paper, ink and hairlines.

Density is form-like rather than airy-marketing: boxes are tight (3px corners, 1px hairline borders, uppercase Archivo labels in a head strip), while chapters are separated by one generous vertical rhythm. Depth is printed, not floated: buttons sit off a hard offset underprint and press into register on hover. Motion is a quiet "settle" (opacity and a 1.5% scale, no vertical drift), plus a single stamp that lands once on the hero sample.

The world deliberately rejects the category default it replaced: gradient heroes, icon-card grids ("heading plus three cards"), rounded dashboard islands, pill badges, dashed eyebrows above every heading, ghost numerals and grid textures.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc-white paper ground with aubergine stamp ink as the single action colour.
Labelled boxes (3px radius, hairline border, uppercase label head) as the primary container.
Ledgers: 2px ink top rule, hairlines between rows.
Archivo display and labels, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next body, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for figures only.
Buttons with a hard offset underprint that press in on hover.
Dark sections re-point role colours via a tone attribute; components never change.

rules.name: The Tone Re-point Rule
rules.body: Dark sections are made with `data-tone="inverse"`, which re-points the role variables (ink becomes the light zinc, muted ink the pale plum, lines the mid plum, primary a light plum chip with dark text, focus the light zinc). A paper box inside a dark section restores light roles with `data-tone="paper"`. Never darken a section by hand-picking light text colours or opacity utilities.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Aubergine is the only colour that means "act". Status colours describe results; steel encodes data. Neither is ever used for a call to action.

rules.name: The Paired Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every foreground/background pairing in use is listed in the token file's contrast pairs and tested (text 4.5:1, control borders and focus 3:1). A new pairing is added to that list before it ships.

rules.name: The Four Tiers Rule
rules.body: A heading takes one of the tier classes (display, chapter, title, label) and never sets its own size.

rules.name: The Label Names Content Rule
rules.body: A label names the content of a box or column. It never sits above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Figures Are Typed Rule
rules.body: Any quantity a user could copy onto a declaration (money, tonnes, dates, CN codes) is set in the mono figure face with tabular numerals. Prose numbers are not.

rules.name: The Press-Into-Register Rule
rules.body: Interactive press feedback is a translation toward the underprint, never a raised lift or a glow. Ghost buttons and text links have no underprint; their hover thickens the underline from 1px to 2px.

dos: **Do** put content in labelled boxes (3px, hairline, uppercase label head) and lists in ledgers (2px ink top rule, hairline rows).
**Do** set every money, mass, date and code value in the mono figure face with tabular numerals.
**Do** make dark sections with the inverse tone attribute and let the role variables flip; use the paper tone for a light box inside them.
**Do** keep aubergine as the only action colour, and show status with icon, text and tone together.
**Do** use one curve (`cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1)`) and the three durations (160ms state, 320ms stamp, 560ms reveal); honour reduced motion.
**Do** use the one shared section gap for every chapter.
donts: **Don't** place an eyebrow label above a heading; labels name box and column content only.
**Don't** build "heading plus three icon cards" grids; use a ledger or a single divided box.
**Don't** use pill badges or 12px-plus rounded cards; corners stop at 6px (radio indicators excepted).
**Don't** use gradient heroes, grid textures, ghost numerals or decorative italic display phrases.
**Don't** lift buttons with soft shadows or glows; they press into their underprint.
**Don't** tilt more than one stamp per artefact, and reserve the tilt for "Sample" or the 404 stamp.
**Don't** use vertical slide-in entry motion; reveals settle in place.
**Don't** set a heading's size directly; pick a type tier.
